description: User-sigchain device key binding (#2496; spec 2026-11-25-v2-device-linking-and-recovery §5-§6, §5 as revised 2026-11-26): the genesis user_init and device_add each name the device's X-Wing key with format 2 and its possession signature (pop), and the refusals a verifier must make. Every case is opened with verify_user_sigchains over its chains (each chain verified, then cross-user key reuse refused); a positive expects each chain's activeDeviceKeys, a negative names the closed rejection code. pop = Ed25519(device, utf8(L_DEVICE_POP) || 0x00 || SHA-256(lp(utf8(user)) || lp(signingPk) || lp(encryptionPk) || u16be(format))), lp = u16be length prefix. Format 2 = X-Wing (draft-connolly-cfrg-xwing-kem-06).
